title: Fixed-scalar weakly-etale localization on coefficient-sized sites
statement: For a scheme Y, an object U of its coefficient-sized pro-etale site, and a commutative ring k in the coefficient universe, put Z=U.left. There exists an equivalence S from sheaves of k-modules on the coefficient-sized pro-etale site of Z to sheaves of k-modules on the coefficient-sized slice at U. Composing fixed-scalar inverse image along U.hom (as in [def-sfb-affine-locally-constructible-proetale-modules]) with S gives restriction to U. For every k-module M, S sends the constant sheaf with value M on Z to the constant sheaf with value M on the slice. No assumption is made on the ring, the module or the schemes.

proof.text: Conjugate the concrete weakly-etale localization equivalence by AsSmall, using Over.postEquiv. Covers correspond: overEquiv commutes with postcomposition, the induced AsSmall topology corresponds to covers, and the middle site equivalence preserves covers. Apply Mathlib Equivalence.sheafCongr.

Composition with U.hom is left adjoint to scheme base change. Conjugate this adjunction by AsSmall and lift it to precomposition on sheaves. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the specified fixed-scalar inverse image with precomposition along composition. After the site equivalence this functor is precomposition by Over.forget U: the component is the identity on the underlying scheme, with its structural equation given by Over.w.

The site equivalence is continuous and cocontinuous. Its precomposition commutes with sheafification. Apply that proved natural comparison to the constant presheaf with value M to obtain the constant-sheaf comparison.

theorem coefficient_slice_fixed_module_equivalence
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, u} Y)
    (k : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing k] :
    ∃ S : Sheaf (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} (AsSmall.down.obj U).left)
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) ≌
        Sheaf ((coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over U) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k),
      Nonempty (coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, u} (AsSmall.down.obj U).hom k ⋙
        S.functor ≅ (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).overPullback
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k) U) ∧
      ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} k,
        Nonempty (S.functor.obj
          ((constantSheaf
            (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} (AsSmall.down.obj U).left)
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)).obj M) ≅
          (constantSheaf ((coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, u} Y).over U)
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} k)).obj M)
